div.div:
Why the signal table also needs CDC
Writing OPEN and CLOSE rows is not enough. The connector must read those markers through the same CDC stream as Outbox changes. That shared order tells it which live events happened during the chunk.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 836px; height: 1px; padding-top: 960px; margin-left: 875px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Result for this example
The destination gets the newer live event for row 42, not the older snapshot READ. It gets READ events for unchanged rows after CLOSE. Live streaming never stops.
